item.title: Gene Function Search Tool
item.description: A new tool for searching gene functions curated from scientific publications is here. Curators from the legumeinfo team have been distilling evidence for gene functions from the literature into structured reports as represented by this example for soybean. Ten species across eight genera currently have some representation, with the majority in G. max and M. truncatula. In addition to the full curation of gene function, gene symbols associated with gene models (currently limited to soybean) have been incorporated into the mines, allowing more convenient search. We hope to update the data available for these purposes on an ongoing basis. As always, if you have suggestions for content additions or improved functionality please contact us.

item.title: Pangene Lookup Tool
item.description: A new tool for finding corresponding genes within genera based on the concept of pangene sets is available here. Lists of up to 100 input genes can be mapped to the corresponding genes in targeted annotations from other species within the genera, and tables of correspondences can be downloaded in tabular form. Pangene sets derived with the tool Pandagma, are available for genera with numerous sequenced genomes available, initially Arachis, Cicer, Glycine, Medicago, Phaseolus, Vigna. The lookup tool can also be used to find correspondences between genes from different versions of the same genome. Please give it a try and let us know what you think!

item.title: Data updates
item.description:
Several new genomes and annotations have been made available in LIS:

  • reference quality Trifolium pratense and Vicia villosa genomes from the group at USDA Dairy Forage Cell Wall Biology and Utilization Research
  • haplotype-resolved genomes for Chamaecrista fasciculata and Cercis canadensis from JGI’s Phytozome

We have also included single-cell experiments from recent publications from the Libault lab, for Medicago truncatula and Glycine max.

In addition, several bulk RNA-seq experiments have been added, e.g. soybean data from JGI Plant Gene Atlas analyzed against the latest Wm82.gnm6.ann1 reference and appearing in gene report pages in LegumeMine.
